privacy.title: Why we need your number and your voice
privacy.numberRequired: Parakh needs your mobile number to create your account and keep your reports linked to you.
privacy.notAnonymous: Reporting on Parakh is not anonymous. Each report is linked to your account.
privacy.numberForSignIn: Your number is used to sign you in with a one-time code sent by SMS.
privacy.staffNeverSee: Officials, representatives and contractors never receive your number.
privacy.voiceStored: When you describe an issue by voice, the original recording is stored.
privacy.aiErrors: A computer system (AI) turns your recording into Urdu text. That text may contain mistakes.
privacy.aiProvider: The AI service that will process recordings has not been chosen yet. This notice will be updated before release.
privacy.reviewBeforeSend: You read and correct the Urdu text before your report is sent.
privacy.smsOptional: SMS updates about your reports are optional, and you choose them separately.
privacy.withdraw: You can turn optional choices off later without losing your account.

consent.title: Your choices
consent.intro: Each choice is separate. The first two are needed to create an account.
consent.account: I agree that Parakh creates my account and processes my information to handle my reports.
consent.voice: I agree that Parakh stores my voice recordings and processes them with AI.
consent.sms: Send me SMS updates about my reports.
consent.requiredMissing: Both required choices are needed to continue. You can still go back.

phone.title: Your mobile number
phone.reminder: We send a one-time code to this number. It is the only identifier Parakh asks for.
phone.label: Mobile number

phone.offline: You need an internet connection to sign in.
phone.wait: Please wait {{seconds}} seconds before asking for another code.
phone.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
phone.consentChanged: The consent text has changed. Please review your choices again.
